headline: Goldman Sachs Infrastructure Acquires Liquid Environmental Solutions
source: Research and Markets / Grease Trapper Market Report
summary: Infrastructure at Goldman Sachs Alternatives announced definitive agreement to acquire Liquid Environmental Solutions, a leading provider of non-hazardous liquid waste management services in the United States, from Audax Private Equity. Founded in 2002, LES is a leading national service provider managing non-hazardous liquid waste including grease traps, oil water separators, used cooking oil and other non-hazardous liquid waste.

headline: Goldman Sachs Alternatives Acquires Liquid Environmental Solutions
summary: Infrastructure at Goldman Sachs Alternatives announced a definitive agreement to acquire Liquid Environmental Solutions, a leading provider of non-hazardous liquid waste management services in the United States, from Audax Private Equity.
